rows.accepted_paraphrases: ["People doing substantially the same work should not be paid differently without a real lawful reason tied to the job.","A materially equivalent statement of the Equal Pay for Equal Work is acceptable without the exact case name or section number."]
rows.material_contradictions: ["States the opposite of the Equal Pay for Equal Work.","Treats a qualified rule as absolute or omits a condition that changes the legal result."]
rows.exceptions_or_limits: Different responsibilities, qualifications, performance, tenure, location, or a valid compensation system may justify different pay when genuinely applied and not used as a pretext.
rows.primary_authority: International School Alliance of Educators v. Quisumbing

rows.subject: Criminal Law
rows.doctrine_title: Nullum Crimen, Nulla Poena Sine Lege
rows.canonical_meaning: There is no crime or penalty without a law defining and punishing the act before it was committed; penal laws are strictly construed against the State and may not be extended by analogy.
rows.plain_language_meaning: A person cannot be punished for conduct that no prior law clearly made criminal.
rows.required_concepts: ["prior penal law must define the offense and penalty","ambiguity is strictly construed against penal liability"]
rows.accepted_paraphrases: ["A person cannot be punished for conduct that no prior law clearly made criminal.","A materially equivalent statement of the Nullum Crimen, Nulla Poena Sine Lege is acceptable without the exact case name or section number."]
rows.material_contradictions: ["States the opposite of the Nullum Crimen, Nulla Poena Sine Lege.","Treats a qualified rule as absolute or omits a condition that changes the legal result."]
rows.exceptions_or_limits: Strict construction does not permit courts to defeat clear legislative text, and favorable penal laws may receive retroactive effect under Article 22 subject to its limits.

rows.subject: Criminal Law
rows.doctrine_title: Mala in Se and Mala Prohibita
rows.canonical_meaning: Mala in se are inherently wrongful acts for which criminal intent is generally material; mala prohibita are prohibited by statute, where proof of the prohibited voluntary act may suffice unless the statute requires knowledge, willfulness, or another mental state.
rows.plain_language_meaning: Some crimes punish an evil act and usually require criminal intent; regulatory offenses may punish the prohibited act itself, but the statute can still require a guilty mind.
rows.required_concepts: ["distinction turns on inherent wrong versus statutory prohibition","the governing statute determines the required mental state"]
rows.accepted_paraphrases: ["Some crimes punish an evil act and usually require criminal intent; regulatory offenses may punish the prohibited act itself, but the statute can still require a guilty mind.","A materially equivalent statement of the Mala in Se and Mala Prohibita is acceptable without the exact case name or section number."]
rows.material_contradictions: ["States the opposite of the Mala in Se and Mala Prohibita.","Treats a qualified rule as absolute or omits a condition that changes the legal result."]
rows.exceptions_or_limits: Not every offense in a special law is malum prohibitum, and mistake or good faith may matter when the statute includes a mens rea element.

rows.subject: Criminal Law
rows.canonical_meaning: An honest and reasonable mistake of fact may negate criminal intent when the act would have been lawful had the facts been as the accused believed, provided the accused was without fault or carelessness.
rows.plain_language_meaning: A reasonable, blameless factual mistake can excuse a person who would have acted lawfully if the believed facts were true.
rows.required_concepts: ["honest and reasonable factual mistake","act would be lawful on the supposed facts","no fault or negligence"]
rows.accepted_paraphrases: ["A reasonable, blameless factual mistake can excuse a person who would have acted lawfully if the believed facts were true.","A materially equivalent statement of the Mistake of Fact is acceptable without the exact case name or section number."]
rows.material_contradictions: ["States the opposite of the Mistake of Fact.","Treats a qualified rule as absolute or omits a condition that changes the legal result."]
rows.exceptions_or_limits: The defense does not apply to a mistake of law, an unreasonable belief, negligence, or an offense that does not require the negated intent.

rows.subject: Criminal Law
rows.canonical_meaning: When a person directs a felonious act at an intended victim but accidentally harms another, the criminal intent generally follows the act to the actual victim, with liability determined under the rules on resulting felonies and complex crimes.
rows.plain_language_meaning: Missing the intended victim and hitting someone else usually does not erase criminal responsibility.
rows.required_concepts: ["felonious intent was directed at one victim","the blow or shot strikes another","intent generally transfers to the actual harm"]
rows.accepted_paraphrases: ["Missing the intended victim and hitting someone else usually does not erase criminal responsibility.","A materially equivalent statement of the Aberratio Ictus or Transferred Intent is acceptable without the exact case name or section number."]
rows.material_contradictions: ["States the opposite of the Aberratio Ictus or Transferred Intent.","Treats a qualified rule as absolute or omits a condition that changes the legal result."]
rows.exceptions_or_limits: The precise offense and penalty depend on all intended and actual results, attempted or frustrated stages, and Article 48 where applicable.

rows.subject: Criminal Law
rows.canonical_meaning: Mistake in the victim’s identity does not ordinarily exempt an offender who intentionally attacks a person and causes the same kind of criminal harm intended.
rows.plain_language_meaning: Killing or injuring the wrong person by mistaken identity usually remains criminal.
rows.required_concepts: ["offender intentionally attacks a person","victim identity differs from what offender believed","mistake ordinarily does not erase liability"]
rows.accepted_paraphrases: ["Killing or injuring the wrong person by mistaken identity usually remains criminal.","A materially equivalent statement of the Error in Personae is acceptable without the exact case name or section number."]
rows.material_contradictions: ["States the opposite of the Error in Personae.","Treats a qualified rule as absolute or omits a condition that changes the legal result."]
rows.exceptions_or_limits: The variance may affect the applicable offense or penalty when the intended and actual harms or victim qualities differ.

rows.subject: Criminal Law
rows.canonical_meaning: It is mitigating when the offender did not intend to commit so grave a wrong as that actually caused, shown by a marked disproportion between the means employed, the intent, and the resulting harm.
rows.plain_language_meaning: A much worse result than the offender meant may mitigate punishment when the facts genuinely show limited intent.
rows.required_concepts: ["actual harm is substantially graver than intended","circumstances objectively show the lesser intent"]
rows.accepted_paraphrases: ["A much worse result than the offender meant may mitigate punishment when the facts genuinely show limited intent.","A materially equivalent statement of the Praeter Intentionem is acceptable without the exact case name or section number."]
rows.material_contradictions: ["States the opposite of the Praeter Intentionem.","Treats a qualified rule as absolute or omits a condition that changes the legal result."]
rows.exceptions_or_limits: The offender bears the evidentiary burden for mitigation; use of a deadly weapon, repeated attacks, or conduct naturally producing the result may defeat the claim.

rows.subject: Criminal Law
rows.canonical_meaning: An impossible crime exists when a person performs acts that would be an offense against persons or property but completion is inherently impossible or the means are inadequate or ineffectual, with evil intent and no other violation of law.
rows.plain_language_meaning: The law may punish a seriously intended crime that could never succeed, if the act does not already constitute another offense.
rows.required_concepts: ["evil intent to commit an offense against persons or property","inherent impossibility or inadequate means","act is not another violation of law"]
rows.accepted_paraphrases: ["The law may punish a seriously intended crime that could never succeed, if the act does not already constitute another offense.","A materially equivalent statement of the Impossible Crime is acceptable without the exact case name or section number."]
rows.material_contradictions: ["States the opposite of the Impossible Crime.","Treats a qualified rule as absolute or omits a condition that changes the legal result."]
rows.exceptions_or_limits: Legal impossibility, physical impossibility, and ineffectual means must be distinguished from a punishable attempt that could have succeeded.

rows.subject: Criminal Law
rows.doctrine_title: Act of One Is the Act of All
rows.canonical_meaning: Once conspiracy is proved beyond reasonable doubt by agreement and unity of purpose in committing the offense, each conspirator is liable for acts done by the others in furtherance of the common design.
rows.plain_language_meaning: People who knowingly join one criminal plan can each answer for acts carrying out that plan.
rows.required_concepts: ["conspiracy must be proved beyond reasonable doubt","agreement and coordinated action toward a common design","acts must further that design"]
rows.accepted_paraphrases: ["People who knowingly join one criminal plan can each answer for acts carrying out that plan.","A materially equivalent statement of the Act of One Is the Act of All is acceptable without the exact case name or section number."]
rows.material_contradictions: ["States the opposite of the Act of One Is the Act of All.","Treats a qualified rule as absolute or omits a condition that changes the legal result."]
rows.exceptions_or_limits: Mere presence, knowledge, association, or acquiescence is insufficient; acts outside the common design may remain the sole actor’s responsibility.

rows.subject: Criminal Law
rows.canonical_meaning: A person committing a felony is liable for the natural and logical consequences of the unlawful act even if the final injury differs from what was intended, unless an efficient intervening cause breaks the causal chain.
rows.plain_language_meaning: Someone who starts a felony generally answers for its natural consequences unless a new independent cause produces the harm.
rows.required_concepts: ["initial intentional felony","result is a natural and logical consequence","no efficient intervening cause"]
rows.accepted_paraphrases: ["Someone who starts a felony generally answers for its natural consequences unless a new independent cause produces the harm.","A materially equivalent statement of the Proximate Cause under Article 4 is acceptable without the exact case name or section number."]
rows.material_contradictions: ["States the opposite of the Proximate Cause under Article 4.","Treats a qualified rule as absolute or omits a condition that changes the legal result."]
rows.exceptions_or_limits: The rule requires an intentional felony at the outset; it does not eliminate causation, and a truly independent superseding event may break liability.

rows.subject: Criminal Law
rows.canonical_meaning: Several acts may constitute one continued crime when they arise from a single criminal resolution, violate the same penal provision, and are performed with close unity of purpose, time, and circumstance.
rows.plain_language_meaning: Closely connected acts driven by one criminal plan may count as one continued offense rather than many.
rows.required_concepts: ["single criminal resolution","same penal provision","close factual unity of purpose and circumstances"]
rows.accepted_paraphrases: ["Closely connected acts driven by one criminal plan may count as one continued offense rather than many.","A materially equivalent statement of the Delito Continuado or Continued Crime is acceptable without the exact case name or section number."]
rows.material_contradictions: ["States the opposite of the Delito Continuado or Continued Crime.","Treats a qualified rule as absolute or omits a condition that changes the legal result."]
rows.exceptions_or_limits: The doctrine is exceptional; distinct victims, renewed intent, substantial breaks, or separate statutory interests commonly support separate offenses.

rows.subject: Remedial Law, Legal and Judicial Ethics, with Practical Exercises
rows.canonical_meaning: Although higher courts may share original jurisdiction over extraordinary writs, parties ordinarily must first file in the lowest court competent to grant relief and must justify any direct resort to a higher court.
rows.plain_language_meaning: Start in the proper lower court unless exceptional reasons truly require going straight to a higher one.
rows.required_concepts: ["concurrent jurisdiction does not mean unrestricted choice of forum","direct resort requires a recognized exceptional reason"]
rows.accepted_paraphrases: ["Start in the proper lower court unless exceptional reasons truly require going straight to a higher one.","A materially equivalent statement of the Hierarchy of Courts is acceptable without the exact case name or section number."]
rows.material_contradictions: ["States the opposite of the Hierarchy of Courts.","Treats a qualified rule as absolute or omits a condition that changes the legal result."]
rows.exceptions_or_limits: The hierarchy is a policy, not a limit on subject-matter jurisdiction. Transcendental importance alone does not automatically excuse nonobservance.
rows.primary_authority: Gios-Samar, Inc. v. Department of Transportation and Communications

rows.subject: Remedial Law, Legal and Judicial Ethics, with Practical Exercises
rows.canonical_meaning: A final judgment on the merits by a court of competent jurisdiction bars a later action between the same parties or their privies on the same claim; even when the causes differ, an issue actually and necessarily resolved may be conclusive.
rows.plain_language_meaning: A final valid judgment prevents the same parties from relitigating the same claim, and sometimes the same decisive issue.
rows.required_concepts: ["final judgment on the merits by a competent court","identity or privity of parties","bar by former judgment or conclusiveness of judgment"]
rows.accepted_paraphrases: ["A final valid judgment prevents the same parties from relitigating the same claim, and sometimes the same decisive issue.","A materially equivalent statement of the Res Judicata is acceptable without the exact case name or section number."]
rows.material_contradictions: ["States the opposite of the Res Judicata.","Treats a qualified rule as absolute or omits a condition that changes the legal result."]
rows.exceptions_or_limits: The two aspects have different identity requirements. A void judgment, a nonfinal ruling, or an issue not actually necessary to the first judgment does not receive the same preclusive effect.

rows.subject: Remedial Law, Legal and Judicial Ethics, with Practical Exercises
rows.canonical_meaning: A legal ruling made in an earlier appeal generally binds the parties and courts in later stages of the same case as to matters actually resolved.
rows.plain_language_meaning: Once an appellate court settles a legal point in a case, that point normally stays settled as the same case continues.
rows.required_concepts: ["prior appellate determination in the same case","the resolved legal point governs later stages"]
rows.accepted_paraphrases: ["Once an appellate court settles a legal point in a case, that point normally stays settled as the same case continues.","A materially equivalent statement of the Law of the Case is acceptable without the exact case name or section number."]
rows.material_contradictions: ["States the opposite of the Law of the Case.","Treats a qualified rule as absolute or omits a condition that changes the legal result."]
rows.exceptions_or_limits: The doctrine differs from res judicata and may yield in exceptional circumstances such as an intervening controlling law or a clear need to prevent grave injustice.

rows.subject: Remedial Law, Legal and Judicial Ethics, with Practical Exercises
rows.canonical_meaning: Once a judgment becomes final and executory, it may no longer be modified even to correct an error of fact or law, except for recognized narrow exceptions.
rows.plain_language_meaning: A final judgment is ordinarily fixed and must be enforced as written.
rows.required_concepts: ["final and executory judgment is no longer alterable","execution must conform to the judgment"]
rows.accepted_paraphrases: ["A final judgment is ordinarily fixed and must be enforced as written.","A materially equivalent statement of the Immutability of Final Judgments is acceptable without the exact case name or section number."]
rows.material_contradictions: ["States the opposite of the Immutability of Final Judgments.","Treats a qualified rule as absolute or omits a condition that changes the legal result."]
rows.exceptions_or_limits: Recognized exceptions include clerical correction, nunc pro tunc entries that record rather than change action, void judgments, and supervening events that make execution unjust or impossible.
rows.primary_authority: Rodriguez v. San Roque Metals, Inc.

rows.subject: Remedial Law, Legal and Judicial Ethics, with Practical Exercises
rows.canonical_meaning: A party receives a fresh full appeal period from receipt of the order denying a timely motion for new trial or reconsideration in judicial proceedings covered by the rule.
rows.plain_language_meaning: After a timely reconsideration motion is denied, the appeal clock generally restarts for the full period in covered court cases.
rows.required_concepts: ["timely motion for new trial or reconsideration","fresh appeal period begins upon receipt of denial"]
rows.accepted_paraphrases: ["After a timely reconsideration motion is denied, the appeal clock generally restarts for the full period in covered court cases.","A materially equivalent statement of the Fresh Period Rule is acceptable without the exact case name or section number."]
rows.material_contradictions: ["States the opposite of the Fresh Period Rule.","Treats a qualified rule as absolute or omits a condition that changes the legal result."]
rows.exceptions_or_limits: The rule does not automatically govern administrative appeals or special statutory remedies whose text fixes a different period.

rows.subject: Remedial Law, Legal and Judicial Ethics, with Practical Exercises
rows.canonical_meaning: A court of coordinate and concurrent jurisdiction generally may not interfere with, review, or restrain the orders and processes of another coequal court.
rows.plain_language_meaning: One trial court normally cannot stop or revise what another equal court is doing.
rows.required_concepts: ["coordinate courts do not review or enjoin one another","relief is sought through the proper appellate or procedural route"]
rows.accepted_paraphrases: ["One trial court normally cannot stop or revise what another equal court is doing.","A materially equivalent statement of the Judicial Stability or Non-Interference is acceptable without the exact case name or section number."]
rows.material_contradictions: ["States the opposite of the Judicial Stability or Non-Interference.","Treats a qualified rule as absolute or omits a condition that changes the legal result."]
rows.exceptions_or_limits: The rule assumes both courts act within lawful authority and does not eliminate remedies directed to the proper higher court.

rows.subject: Remedial Law, Legal and Judicial Ethics, with Practical Exercises
rows.doctrine_title: Jurisdiction Determined by Allegations and Law
rows.canonical_meaning: Subject-matter jurisdiction is conferred by law and determined from the material allegations and relief sought at the commencement of the action, not by defenses or the eventual merits.
rows.plain_language_meaning: The law and the complaint’s core allegations decide which court has power, not the defendant’s answer or who later wins.
rows.required_concepts: ["jurisdiction comes only from law","material allegations and relief at filing control"]
rows.accepted_paraphrases: ["The law and the complaint’s core allegations decide which court has power, not the defendant’s answer or who later wins.","A materially equivalent statement of the Jurisdiction Determined by Allegations and Law is acceptable without the exact case name or section number."]
rows.material_contradictions: ["States the opposite of the Jurisdiction Determined by Allegations and Law.","Treats a qualified rule as absolute or omits a condition that changes the legal result."]
rows.exceptions_or_limits: Bad-faith or sham allegations cannot manufacture jurisdiction, and later events affect jurisdiction only when a governing rule or statute so provides.

rows.subject: Remedial Law, Legal and Judicial Ethics, with Practical Exercises
rows.canonical_meaning: Once a court lawfully acquires jurisdiction, it generally retains jurisdiction until final disposition despite later changes that would have prevented original acquisition.
rows.plain_language_meaning: A court that properly obtained the case normally keeps it through the end.
rows.required_concepts: ["jurisdiction was validly acquired at commencement","later events ordinarily do not divest it"]
rows.accepted_paraphrases: ["A court that properly obtained the case normally keeps it through the end.","A materially equivalent statement of the Adherence of Jurisdiction is acceptable without the exact case name or section number."]
rows.material_contradictions: ["States the opposite of the Adherence of Jurisdiction.","Treats a qualified rule as absolute or omits a condition that changes the legal result."]
rows.exceptions_or_limits: A later statute expressly made applicable, loss of an indispensable jurisdictional fact under a governing special rule, or proof that jurisdiction never attached may produce a different result.

rows.subject: Remedial Law, Legal and Judicial Ethics, with Practical Exercises
rows.canonical_meaning: Forum shopping occurs when a party repetitively seeks substantially the same relief in multiple tribunals, shown by identity of parties, rights asserted and reliefs, such that judgment in one would amount to res judicata in another.
rows.plain_language_meaning: A litigant may not run the same dispute through multiple courts in hopes of a favorable result.
rows.required_concepts: ["substantially identical parties, rights, and reliefs","a judgment in one would preclude or materially affect the other"]
rows.accepted_paraphrases: ["A litigant may not run the same dispute through multiple courts in hopes of a favorable result.","A materially equivalent statement of the Forum Shopping is acceptable without the exact case name or section number."]
rows.material_contradictions: ["States the opposite of the Forum Shopping.","Treats a qualified rule as absolute or omits a condition that changes the legal result."]
rows.exceptions_or_limits: Related proceedings are not automatically forum shopping when they seek distinct reliefs under different rights; willfulness affects sanctions and dismissal consequences.
rows.primary_authority: 2019 Amendments to the Rules of Civil Procedure

rows.subject: Remedial Law, Legal and Judicial Ethics, with Practical Exercises
rows.canonical_meaning: Procedural rules may be relaxed in exceptional circumstances to secure substantial justice, but a party must explain the noncompliance and show a compelling equitable basis; liberality is not a license to ignore deadlines and requirements.
rows.plain_language_meaning: Courts can forgive a procedural mistake for strong reasons of justice, but rules still matter and excuses must be concrete.
rows.required_concepts: ["rules serve substantial justice","relaxation requires exceptional and explained circumstances"]
rows.accepted_paraphrases: ["Courts can forgive a procedural mistake for strong reasons of justice, but rules still matter and excuses must be concrete.","A materially equivalent statement of the Liberal Construction of Procedural Rules is acceptable without the exact case name or section number."]
rows.material_contradictions: ["States the opposite of the Liberal Construction of Procedural Rules.","Treats a qualified rule as absolute or omits a condition that changes the legal result."]
rows.exceptions_or_limits: Finality, due process, orderly procedure, and prejudice to the opposing party weigh heavily against casual relaxation.
rows.primary_authority: Vette Industrial Sales Co., Inc. v. Cheng

rows.subject: Remedial Law, Legal and Judicial Ethics, with Practical Exercises
rows.doctrine_title: Burden of Proof and Burden of Evidence
rows.canonical_meaning: Burden of proof is the duty to establish a claim or defense by the required quantum and generally remains with the party who asserts it; burden of evidence is the need to produce evidence at a particular stage and may shift as prima facie showings are made.
rows.plain_language_meaning: The ultimate duty to prove a case usually stays put, while the need to answer the other side’s evidence can shift during trial.
rows.required_concepts: ["burden of proof is the ultimate persuasive duty","burden of evidence may shift during the case"]
rows.accepted_paraphrases: ["The ultimate duty to prove a case usually stays put, while the need to answer the other side’s evidence can shift during trial.","A materially equivalent statement of the Burden of Proof and Burden of Evidence is acceptable without the exact case name or section number."]
rows.material_contradictions: ["States the opposite of the Burden of Proof and Burden of Evidence.","Treats a qualified rule as absolute or omits a condition that changes the legal result."]
rows.exceptions_or_limits: Statutory presumptions and special proceedings may allocate burdens differently; neither burden changes the governing quantum of proof.
rows.primary_authority: Malate Construction and Development Corporation v. Extraordinary Realty Agents and Brokers Cooperative

rows.subject: Remedial Law, Legal and Judicial Ethics, with Practical Exercises
rows.canonical_meaning: When the evidence for conviction and acquittal is evenly balanced, the constitutional presumption of innocence requires acquittal because the prosecution has not proved guilt beyond reasonable doubt.
rows.plain_language_meaning: If the evidence is truly tied, the accused wins because the State carries the burden of proof.
rows.required_concepts: ["evidence is evenly balanced","presumption of innocence resolves the doubt for the accused"]
rows.accepted_paraphrases: ["If the evidence is truly tied, the accused wins because the State carries the burden of proof.","A materially equivalent statement of the Equipoise Rule is acceptable without the exact case name or section number."]
rows.material_contradictions: ["States the opposite of the Equipoise Rule.","Treats a qualified rule as absolute or omits a condition that changes the legal result."]
rows.exceptions_or_limits: The rule applies only after evaluating all admissible evidence; it is not a substitute for that evaluation or a demand that every minor fact be undisputed.

rows.subject: Remedial Law, Legal and Judicial Ethics, with Practical Exercises
rows.canonical_meaning: Evidence directly or derivatively obtained through a government violation of the constitutional rights against unreasonable searches or compelled self-incrimination is inadmissible, subject to recognized attenuation and other exceptions under applicable law.
rows.plain_language_meaning: Illegally obtained evidence—and evidence produced by that illegality—may be excluded.
rows.required_concepts: ["a constitutional violation by State action","direct or derivative evidence is excluded"]
rows.accepted_paraphrases: ["Illegally obtained evidence—and evidence produced by that illegality—may be excluded.","A materially equivalent statement of the Fruit of the Poisonous Tree is acceptable without the exact case name or section number."]
rows.material_contradictions: ["States the opposite of the Fruit of the Poisonous Tree.","Treats a qualified rule as absolute or omits a condition that changes the legal result."]
rows.exceptions_or_limits: Independent source, inevitable discovery, attenuation, standing, and private-search principles require separate analysis; not every evidentiary error creates poisoned fruit.

rows.subject: Remedial Law, Legal and Judicial Ethics, with Practical Exercises
rows.canonical_meaning: Police may seize evidence without a warrant when they are lawfully in the position to see it, its incriminating character is immediately apparent, and its discovery is inadvertent under the doctrine’s applicable formulation.
rows.plain_language_meaning: An officer lawfully present may seize obviously incriminating evidence already exposed to view.
rows.required_concepts: ["lawful initial intrusion or position","item is plainly visible","incriminating nature is immediately apparent"]
rows.accepted_paraphrases: ["An officer lawfully present may seize obviously incriminating evidence already exposed to view.","A materially equivalent statement of the Plain View Doctrine is acceptable without the exact case name or section number."]
rows.material_contradictions: ["States the opposite of the Plain View Doctrine.","Treats a qualified rule as absolute or omits a condition that changes the legal result."]
rows.exceptions_or_limits: Plain view cannot justify an unlawful entry or a further exploratory search, and an officer must have probable cause to associate the item with crime.

rows.subject: Remedial Law, Legal and Judicial Ethics, with Practical Exercises
rows.canonical_meaning: After a lawful arrest based on probable cause, officers may contemporaneously search the arrestee and the area within immediate control for weapons and destructible evidence.
rows.plain_language_meaning: A valid arrest permits a limited safety-and-evidence search of the person and nearby reachable area.
rows.required_concepts: ["arrest is independently lawful and ordinarily precedes the search","search is contemporaneous and limited in scope"]
rows.accepted_paraphrases: ["A valid arrest permits a limited safety-and-evidence search of the person and nearby reachable area.","A materially equivalent statement of the Search Incident to Lawful Arrest is acceptable without the exact case name or section number."]
rows.material_contradictions: ["States the opposite of the Search Incident to Lawful Arrest.","Treats a qualified rule as absolute or omits a condition that changes the legal result."]
rows.exceptions_or_limits: A search cannot be used to discover probable cause for the arrest, and broader vehicle, digital-device, or premises searches require their own legal basis.

rows.subject: Remedial Law, Legal and Judicial Ethics, with Practical Exercises
rows.canonical_meaning: When the contents of a document are in issue, the original is generally required unless a rules-based exception applies; under the 2019 Rules, a duplicate is ordinarily admissible to the same extent unless authenticity is genuinely questioned or admission would be unfair.
rows.plain_language_meaning: To prove what a document says, use the original or a permitted substitute; ordinary duplicates are now usually acceptable.
rows.required_concepts: ["rule applies when contents are being proved","original, duplicate, or a recognized exception must support the proof"]
rows.accepted_paraphrases: ["To prove what a document says, use the original or a permitted substitute; ordinary duplicates are now usually acceptable.","A materially equivalent statement of the Original Document Rule is acceptable without the exact case name or section number."]
rows.material_contradictions: ["States the opposite of the Original Document Rule.","Treats a qualified rule as absolute or omits a condition that changes the legal result."]
rows.exceptions_or_limits: The rule does not apply when the fact exists independently of the writing, and summaries, public records, lost originals, and opponent-controlled originals have specific requirements.
rows.primary_authority: 2019 Amendments to the Revised Rules on Evidence

rows.subject: Remedial Law, Legal and Judicial Ethics, with Practical Exercises
rows.canonical_meaning: Hearsay is an out-of-court statement offered to prove the truth of what it asserts and is inadmissible unless a rule excludes it from hearsay or provides an exception.
rows.plain_language_meaning: A statement made outside court usually cannot prove its own truth unless an evidence rule allows it.
rows.required_concepts: ["out-of-court statement","offered for truth of the assertion","no applicable exclusion or exception"]
rows.accepted_paraphrases: ["A statement made outside court usually cannot prove its own truth unless an evidence rule allows it.","A materially equivalent statement of the Hearsay Rule is acceptable without the exact case name or section number."]
rows.material_contradictions: ["States the opposite of the Hearsay Rule.","Treats a qualified rule as absolute or omits a condition that changes the legal result."]
rows.exceptions_or_limits: A statement offered for notice, effect on the listener, verbal acts, or another nontruth purpose is not hearsay, though relevance and other objections remain.
rows.primary_authority: 2019 Amendments to the Revised Rules on Evidence

rows.subject: Remedial Law, Legal and Judicial Ethics, with Practical Exercises
rows.canonical_meaning: A person’s rights generally cannot be prejudiced by another’s act, declaration, or omission, and evidence of conduct on one occasion is not admissible merely to prove identical conduct on another, subject to the Rules’ admissions and specific-purpose exceptions.
rows.plain_language_meaning: What someone else said or did usually cannot automatically be used against a different person, and past conduct is not simple proof of repeated conduct.
rows.required_concepts: ["third-party acts or declarations ordinarily do not prejudice another","propensity use of other acts is restricted"]
rows.accepted_paraphrases: ["What someone else said or did usually cannot automatically be used against a different person, and past conduct is not simple proof of repeated conduct.","A materially equivalent statement of the Res Inter Alios Acta is acceptable without the exact case name or section number."]
rows.material_contradictions: ["States the opposite of the Res Inter Alios Acta.","Treats a qualified rule as absolute or omits a condition that changes the legal result."]
rows.exceptions_or_limits: Agency, partnership, conspiracy, co-ownership, adoptive admissions, and proof of intent, plan, identity, habit, or similar permitted purposes have separate requisites.
rows.primary_authority: 2019 Amendments to the Revised Rules on Evidence

rows.subject: Remedial Law, Legal and Judicial Ethics, with Practical Exercises
rows.canonical_meaning: The prosecution must account for each material link in the seizure, marking, inventory, custody, transfer, examination, and presentation of the seized drug so the item in court is shown to be the same and substantially unaltered.
rows.plain_language_meaning: Every important handoff of seized drugs must be credibly explained to preserve identity and integrity.
rows.required_concepts: ["links from seizure through presentation are identified","identity and integrity of the item are preserved"]
rows.accepted_paraphrases: ["Every important handoff of seized drugs must be credibly explained to preserve identity and integrity.","A materially equivalent statement of the Chain of Custody is acceptable without the exact case name or section number."]
rows.material_contradictions: ["States the opposite of the Chain of Custody.","Treats a qualified rule as absolute or omits a condition that changes the legal result."]
rows.exceptions_or_limits: A statutory saving clause may excuse justified deviations only when the prosecution explains the lapse and proves preserved integrity; courts do not presume compliance from silence.

rows.subject: Remedial Law, Legal and Judicial Ethics, with Practical Exercises
rows.canonical_meaning: A second prosecution is barred after a valid complaint or information, a court with jurisdiction, arraignment and plea, and acquittal, conviction, or dismissal without the accused’s express consent, for the same offense or an included offense.
rows.plain_language_meaning: After a valid case reaches the required final point, the State generally cannot prosecute the accused again for the same offense.
rows.required_concepts: ["valid charge and competent court","arraignment and plea","qualifying termination","same or included offense"]
rows.accepted_paraphrases: ["After a valid case reaches the required final point, the State generally cannot prosecute the accused again for the same offense.","A materially equivalent statement of the Double Jeopardy is acceptable without the exact case name or section number."]
rows.material_contradictions: ["States the opposite of the Double Jeopardy.","Treats a qualified rule as absolute or omits a condition that changes the legal result."]
rows.exceptions_or_limits: Dismissal sought by the accused ordinarily prevents attachment unless it amounts to acquittal or falls within recognized exceptions; a void judgment or sham proceeding and review for grave abuse require careful distinction from an appeal on the merits.

rows.subject: Remedial Law, Legal and Judicial Ethics, with Practical Exercises
rows.canonical_meaning: A lawyer must preserve client confidences and secrets acquired in the professional relationship and may disclose them only with informed consent or under a specific legal or ethical exception.
rows.plain_language_meaning: A lawyer must keep client information private unless the client validly agrees or a narrow rule permits disclosure.
rows.required_concepts: ["professional information is protected","disclosure requires consent or a recognized exception"]
rows.accepted_paraphrases: ["A lawyer must keep client information private unless the client validly agrees or a narrow rule permits disclosure.","A materially equivalent statement of the Attorney-Client Confidentiality is acceptable without the exact case name or section number."]
rows.material_contradictions: ["States the opposite of the Attorney-Client Confidentiality.","Treats a qualified rule as absolute or omits a condition that changes the legal result."]
rows.exceptions_or_limits: The duty is broader than evidentiary privilege, continues after representation ends, and is subject to CPRA exceptions such as preventing specified crimes or collecting or defending fees as allowed.
rows.primary_authority: Code of Professional Responsibility and Accountability

rows.subject: Remedial Law, Legal and Judicial Ethics, with Practical Exercises
rows.canonical_meaning: A lawyer must not represent conflicting interests without the informed written consent required by the CPRA and only when competent, loyal, independent representation remains possible.
rows.plain_language_meaning: A lawyer cannot serve clients whose interests pull the lawyer in opposing directions unless the rules truly permit informed consent.
rows.required_concepts: ["actual or significant risk of conflicting loyalty is identified","informed written consent is required only for consentable conflicts"]
rows.accepted_paraphrases: ["A lawyer cannot serve clients whose interests pull the lawyer in opposing directions unless the rules truly permit informed consent.","A materially equivalent statement of the Conflict of Interest is acceptable without the exact case name or section number."]
rows.material_contradictions: ["States the opposite of the Conflict of Interest.","Treats a qualified rule as absolute or omits a condition that changes the legal result."]
rows.exceptions_or_limits: Some conflicts are nonconsentable. Duties to former and prospective clients, imputation within a firm, and personal-interest conflicts have distinct CPRA rules.
rows.primary_authority: Code of Professional Responsibility and Accountability

rows.subject: Remedial Law, Legal and Judicial Ethics, with Practical Exercises
rows.canonical_meaning: When an attorney-fee agreement is absent, unenforceable, or cannot fairly govern completed services, a lawyer may recover the reasonable value of beneficial legal services under quantum meruit, subject to ethical and equitable limits.
rows.plain_language_meaning: A lawyer may receive a reasonable fee for useful work even when the fee contract does not control.
rows.required_concepts: ["valuable legal services were rendered","recovery is limited to reasonable value"]
rows.accepted_paraphrases: ["A lawyer may receive a reasonable fee for useful work even when the fee contract does not control.","A materially equivalent statement of the Quantum Meruit is acceptable without the exact case name or section number."]
rows.material_contradictions: ["States the opposite of the Quantum Meruit.","Treats a qualified rule as absolute or omits a condition that changes the legal result."]
rows.exceptions_or_limits: Quantum meruit does not reward prohibited representation, misconduct, or work that conferred no benefit; reasonableness uses the CPRA factors and judicial oversight.
rows.primary_authority: Code of Professional Responsibility and Accountability

rows.subject: Remedial Law, Legal and Judicial Ethics, with Practical Exercises
rows.canonical_meaning: A lawyer must not knowingly make a false statement, offer false evidence, misquote authority, or conceal controlling law, and must take reasonable remedial measures when the CPRA requires correction.
rows.plain_language_meaning: A lawyer must be truthful with the court and correct serious falsehoods rather than help mislead the judge.
rows.required_concepts: ["no knowing falsehood or false evidence","material legal authority and facts must not be deceptively concealed","required corrective action must be taken"]
rows.accepted_paraphrases: ["A lawyer must be truthful with the court and correct serious falsehoods rather than help mislead the judge.","A materially equivalent statement of the Candor to the Tribunal is acceptable without the exact case name or section number."]
rows.material_contradictions: ["States the opposite of the Candor to the Tribunal.","Treats a qualified rule as absolute or omits a condition that changes the legal result."]
rows.exceptions_or_limits: Candor coexists with confidentiality and loyal advocacy; the CPRA specifies how to resolve conflicts and does not require volunteering every adverse fact outside a governing duty.
rows.primary_authority: Code of Professional Responsibility and Accountability

rows.subject: Remedial Law, Legal and Judicial Ethics, with Practical Exercises
rows.doctrine_title: Cold Neutrality of an Impartial Judge
rows.canonical_meaning: Due process requires not only an actually impartial judge but the appearance of impartiality: a judge must decide from the record and law, free from bias, improper influence, prejudgment, or conduct creating a reasonable perception of partiality.
rows.plain_language_meaning: Judges must be fair and must reasonably appear fair.
rows.required_concepts: ["actual impartiality","appearance of impartiality","decision based on law and the record"]
rows.accepted_paraphrases: ["Judges must be fair and must reasonably appear fair.","A materially equivalent statement of the Cold Neutrality of an Impartial Judge is acceptable without the exact case name or section number."]
rows.material_contradictions: ["States the opposite of the Cold Neutrality of an Impartial Judge.","Treats a qualified rule as absolute or omits a condition that changes the legal result."]
rows.exceptions_or_limits: Adverse rulings alone do not prove bias. Inhibition follows constitutional, procedural, and judicial-conduct standards, including mandatory and discretionary grounds.
rows.primary_authority: 2025 Code of Judicial Conduct and Accountability
